user.title: Innova Cloud (Solution Tech)
user.description: Pick the app you use. Innova's cloud is white-labelled for other brands: each uses the same platform on its own tenant.

credentials.title: Innova account
credentials.description: Use the email and password of your Innova app account. If you signed up with Google or Apple, first set a password with "Forgot password" in the app, or use a session token instead.

token.title: Session token
token.description: Paste the JWT bearer token used by the Innova app (see the README for how to obtain it). Tokens are valid for about one year.

custom_hosts.title: Custom cloud hosts
custom_hosts.description: For a tenant not in the list: the REST base URL and the gRPC host of that brand's cloud (see the README for the naming pattern).

auth.title: Sign in
auth.description: Sign in with the account you use in the app.

error.cannot_connect: Could not reach the Innova cloud

abort.wrong_account: The account is different from the one this entry was set up with

data_description.poll_minutes: Live changes arrive through the event stream; this is only the safety-net poll. 10 minutes is plenty.
